PZZ700-310900-
1254 PM PDT Fri Oct 30 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1017 mb high was 1800 nautical miles west of San Diego and
a 1008 mb low was near Las Vegas, NV. Weak to moderate onshore 
flow will continue through Saturday. There is also a slight 
chance of thunderstorms Saturday night and Sunday morning. Winds
will increase Saturday afternoon and again Sunday afternoon, but
gusts will likely stay under 21 kt. Weak offshore flow will
develop by early Monday. 

$$
